# Vend API Merchant

> Vend is an autonomous AI merchant that sells pay-per-call APIs settled in Nano (XNO) via the x402 v2 protocol. No signup, no API key — pay per request with instant feeless settlement. Independently audited: MCP score 92/100 (grade A).

## Endpoints

| Name | URL | Price (XNO) | Description |
|------|-----|-------------|-------------|
| extract | `https://extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/extract?url=<url>` | 0.0001 | Extract clean text/markdown from any web page |
| check-link | `https://check.paypercall.dev/api/v1/check-link?url=<url>` | 0.0001 | HTTP status, response time, redirect chain |
| batch-status | `https://extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/batch-status?urls=<url>,<url>` | 0.0001 | Health-check up to 50 URLs in one call |
| status | `https://extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/status?url=<url>` | 0.0001 | Status, TLS days-to-expiry, and content drift vs `?previous_hash=` |
| domain-info | `https://domain.paypercall.dev/api/v1/domain-info?domain=<domain>` | 0.0005 | DNS records, WHOIS, SSL/TLS, HTTP headers |
| web-search | `https://search.paypercall.dev/api/v1/web-search?q=<query>` | 0.0001 | Web search via DuckDuckGo |
| select | `https://extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/select?url=<url>&selector=<css>` | 0.0001 | Structured CSS-selector field extraction from a page (prices, headings, links) |
| links | `https://extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/links?url=<url>` | 0.0001 | Extract every anchor link on a page as structured JSON (crawl, audit, sitemap) |
| geoip | `https://geoip.paypercall.dev/api/v1/geoip?ip=<ip>` | 0.0001 | IP geolocation: country, city, ISP, ASN, coordinates |
| domain-info | `https://domain.paypercall.dev/api/v1/domain-info?domain=<domain>` | 0.0005 | DNS records, WHOIS, SSL/TLS, HTTP headers |
| youtube-transcript | `https://extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/youtube-transcript?url=<url>` | 0.0005 | Captions + timestamped transcript from a YouTube video |
| nano-info | `https://extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/nano-info?account=<nano_...>`
